selection.frozen_text: Each evidence item should be assessed against every candidate explanation as consistent, inconsistent or unknown.
selection.frozen_scope: The prescribed comparison includes all listed alternatives and permits unknown assessments.

source_refs.text: A hosted document service exports customer workspaces overnight. Median export time is stable, but roughly one in twenty exports now takes more than an hour instead of ten minutes. Export traces include queue entry, worker start, object reads and archive upload; trace coverage differs across worker versions. Customers cannot be asked to rerun large exports during business hours. The engineering team must plan a safe investigation and choose the next deployment action.
Several plausible explanations can account for an uncertain situation, and available evidence may fit more than one of them.

State the competing explanations explicitly, evaluate each item of evidence against all of them, emphasize evidence that is inconsistent with particular explanations, and test the sensitivity of the resulting comparison to uncertain evidence or assumptions.
The evidence forms a comparative pattern of consistency and inconsistency across the competing explanations, with some items discriminating among them more strongly than others.
Explanations with greater important inconsistency can be weakened or eliminated, leaving a smaller set of alternatives that better survives the observed evidence.

Missing hypotheses, dependent or unreliable evidence, subjective consistency judgments, poor assessment of diagnosticity, and shared assumptions can make the comparison misleading. Surviving contradiction is not proof that the remaining explanation is true.
Build an evidence-by-hypothesis matrix, marking each item consistent, inconsistent or unknown for every explanation and recording reliability and diagnostic value.
Separate queue wait, worker execution, object-read and upload durations only where trace semantics permit.
Repeat the comparison excluding incomplete traces, varying uncertain phase boundaries, stratifying by version and workload, and considering combined causes.

selection.why_selected: Shortlisted only; not admitted to a complete selection. The frozen mapping actively prescribes that comparison while preserving unknown evidence. Source-derived operation is a plausible positive candidate, not a measured fidelity or operation pass.
